reason: I fill up at the office fountain and the water's fine, so I'm not sure what problem a filter solves for me. And I can't buy a bottle for how it looks when the post never even shows me the bottle, and $68 today plus filters forever is a lot for something I can't see.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? 'Up to 150 L' from the supplier isn't a test result. Without lab data on what it removes, I'm paying for a subscription to a placebo.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab results showing what the filter removes from tap water, plus seeing the bottle look good in a real gym setting.
